meta_title: D T Plumbing | Emergency Plumber Derby
meta_description: D T Plumbing Derby provides emergency plumbing repairs, installations, and maintenance across Derbyshire. Fast response, no call-out charge. Call 07968 072887 today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Derby? We arrive fast, diagnose on the spot, and fix most jobs same day.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing Services Across Derby & Derbyshire
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to new boiler installations, we handle all your plumbing needs with speed and reliability.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Water flooding your home? We arrive within the hour to isolate the problem and make it safe. Most leaks repaired permanently same day, with no hidden charges.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Heating gone down in winter? We diagnose and repair most boiler faults on the first visit. New installations come with a 10-year parts guarantee and a manufacturer's warranty.

services.title: Central Heating & Radiator Work
services.desc: Cold radiators, noisy pipes, or slow heat-up? We power-flush systems, install new radiators, and balance your heating for even warmth throughout your home.

services.title: Tap & Bathroom Fitting
services.desc: Upgrading your bathroom or kitchen? We install new taps, mixers, showers, and suites to a high standard. All work is guaranteed for peace of mind.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Blocked drain causing a mess? We clear blockages fast using professional equipment, then CCTV survey the line to spot cracks or tree roots before they become expensive problems.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing & Safety
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with our annual service. We issue a Gas Safe certificate and identify any repairs needed before they fail mid-winter.

about_pullquote: I started D T Plumbing because I hated waiting days for a plumber, or being ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: D T Plumbing was founded on the simple principle that your home emergency shouldn't turn into a nightmare. With over 15 years' experience across Derby and Derbyshire, we've built our reputation by being fast, honest, and fair. We carry most parts on the van and diagnose jobs on the spot — no mystery call-out charges, no endless callbacks.
about_para_2: Hundreds of Derby homeowners and landlords trust us because we answer our phones, we show up when we say we will, and we explain the work in plain English before we start. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe, a boiler breakdown in January, or a planned upgrade, you get the same reliable, professional service every time.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About D T Plumbing

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe in the bathroom on a Sunday morning — absolute panic. Called D T Plumbing and they were round in 40 minutes. Fixed it all, cleaned up the mess, and sorted the damage. Fair price too. Couldn't ask for better. Already recommended them to three neighbours.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in right before Christmas. Called Monday morning, they came same afternoon and fitted a new one by Wednesday. Professional lads, knew exactly what they were doing. The 10-year guarantee is brilliant peace of mind. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: Sarah L.

reviews.text: Been using D T Plumbing for four years now. They service the boiler every year, sorted a radiator problem last winter, and fitted a new kitchen tap last month. Always reliable, never let you down, and prices are reasonable. That's all you need from a local plumber.
reviews.author: James W.
